decisions.reason: The GA4 plugin builds directly on the firm's plugin development and analytics expertise, and GA4 remains the mandatory Google standard, so the firm can keep interpreting client tracking results and refining the plugin.
The retail system interface plugin rests on the firm's core interface competence and supports ongoing client integrations, so it fits the knowledge base the firm can assimilate and improve on.
Relaunch SEO support combines the firm's extensive relaunch project experience with its search marketing know-how, and its dedicated page signals continued strategic commitment.

SEO workshops turn the firm's established search marketing expertise into a low-cost knowledge service with its own page, and client feedback from the workshops is easy to interpret and use for improvement.
